Rules / Formatting

SK0211 The predefined type spelling is not arranged

skala arrange would use a keyword or framework type name under the configured preference.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSemantic
Needs a compilationyes
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

The declaration and member-access preferences are independent. Binding distinguishes System.Int32 from a same-named user type before replacing it with int, or performs the reverse cleanup when configured.

Example

Instead of:

Int32 value = 0;

Write:

int value = 0;

When it does not fire

Only predefined framework types are rewritten; user types with similar names are ignored.

Configuration

  • dotnet_style_predefined_type_for_locals_parameters_members
  • dotnet_style_predefined_type_for_member_access
